description:
IMFSE is the Erasmus Mundus master in fire safety engineering run by Ghent, Edinburgh, Lund and UPC with an eleven-partner network. Applications for 2027-2028 are open now; scholarship files must arrive before 1 February 2027, while self-sponsored applicants have until 1 April (visa-needed) or 1 June 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Ghent-led consortium with Edinburgh, Lund and Barcelona partners
  • Three-tier deadlines: 1 February (scholarship), 1 April (visa), 1 June (no visa)
  • Strong industry contributor network funding student scholarships
  • Graduates in fire engineering consultancy, codes bodies and research

Who Should Apply

Civil, mechanical and architectural engineering graduates with strong physics and modelling basics are the core applicants; interviews may follow within a month of the deadline.

Funding and Costs

IMFSE scholarships funded by the programme's contributor network: participation costs plus living allowance for selected students.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the IMFSE application form on imfse.be and beat the 1 February 2027 scholarship cut-off. Key deadline information: 1 February 2027 (scholarship applications must be submitted before this date). Self-sponsored with visa: 1 April 2027; without visa: 1 June 2027.
